narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel guide and food review for the newly relocated Jodd Fairs (The One Ratchada) night market in Bangkok. It aims to inform viewers about the new location, highlight specific must-try foods (Tom Yum, Milo, Taiwanese snacks), and showcase the cleanliness of facilities to encourage tourism and market visits.
